risk_note: Money path, RV2, the most sensitive of the payout tasks. Adds adminListUnknownPayouts, adminQueryPayoutResult and adminResolveUnknownPayout (W10). Resolving as paid moves a PAYING needs_manual withdrawal to PAID_API with the same voucher as W5, tax_ytd, the event and audit in one transaction; it is refused when the latest query is fail and no recon_channel row whose status query_status_map maps to success exists (#41 pins the mapped value, not mere presence in the map). Resolving as failed is refused for every withdrawal in this version: no WITHDRAW:RETURN and no manual_failed_watch path exists (D10-626, go-live gap 24), because refunding money that has left is a double payment. The manual query only queries once and records kind=query: it never moves state, never transfers, and is deduplicated per request by the processed_events primary key in the same transaction as the attempt row. Rule tests were written in 4 rounds: the fourth went past the limit of 3 by the author's mistake (a tail hid 'attempts exhausted') and was left uncommitted until the owner approved it, approvals 49, which covers only #41 and #42 and one more spec-test round. Not in this task: the W10 late_paid_check enqueue (go-live gap 25, second half), which goes in a separate small task after this merge because a further rule test would be a fifth round outside approvals 49; until it lands, a W10 paid_at on a finished bill day is not rechecked. Domain review by the withdraw line passed (D10-677, and incrementally over #41 and #42 on 2026-11-06 02:10, D10-679). Its three S2 do not block this merge and follow as separate tasks: FU-W10-VOUCHER-CROSSCHECK, FU-W10-LIST-ROW-500, FU-W10-QUERY-DEDUPE.
